control_intents.title: Management trust and recovery
control_intents.intent: Maintain a tested, supported management and recovery path before restrictive or connectivity-affecting changes.

control_intents.title: Single writer per effective setting
control_intents.intent: Assign one policy writer per platform, model, and cohort for every effective setting; reject unknown overlap and priority conflicts.

control_intents.title: Usability-preserving hardening
control_intents.intent: Use Tier 2 as the normal baseline, reserve Tier 1 for dedicated privileged or high-risk cases, and prove supported workflows and recovery before promotion.

control_intents.title: Inventory-backed minimal scope
control_intents.intent: Do not derive group membership or assignments from organizational metadata. Use one approved, inventory-backed scope at a time.
